latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert images to video fast, no login required.

- Instantly turns up to three JPG photos into 1080p video clips based on your prompts.
- Automatic backend connection and temporary free token generation—no user sign-up needed.
- Simple uploads, fast cloud processing (20–40 seconds typical output time).
- Supports multi-track timeline edits, transitions, text overlays, and audio.
- Exports in MP4 and other common formats; max file size 200MB per image.
- Clear error messaging for unsupported formats, size, credits, or session issues.
